_about: States/UTs and districts with LGD codes from the Local Government Directory, Ministry of Panchayati Raj (https://lgdirectory.gov.in). Regenerate with npm run ingest:lgd. 'local' is LGD's local-language name when it is in an Indian script; UP districts also carry 'hi' and former names ('aliases') from datasets/lgd/district-names-up.json.
